description: Línea Lateral Sistema Alcantarillado Sanitario. Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Empresa de Acueducto y Alcantarillado de Bogotá ESP - EAAB. Conducto de alcantarillado con sus correspondientes accesorios, mediante el cual se hace la conexión desde la caja domiciliaria o sumidero a la red local o al pozo de alcantarillado sanitario o combinado. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Empresa de Acueducto y Alcantarillado de Bogotá ESP - EAAB. Its tags are Alcantarillado, Bogotá D.C., Caja, Combinado, Conducto. It offers 1 resource(s) in ESRI REST. The portal shows 2022-10-15 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
